_: События субтитров (subs: build_sub_events) и слоя (overlay: build_overlay_events и insertSpans — кадры показа вставок) для одних и тех же входов: engine/vm/subs.py и engine/vm/overlay.py ↔ web/lib/subs.ts и web/lib/overlay.ts. Времена слов и edit — по исходнику, событий — секунды финала; keep — в порядке финала. render — шкала, на которой монтаж строит слой (render.timeline ↔ renderTimeline): края keep и тизера на целых кадрах, не дальше последнего кадра исходника (limit). Пишет engine/tests/shared_events.py (python3 -m tests.shared_events из engine/).

subs.name: karaoke, three words, a cut and speed
soft, two lines of three, accent words hidden
pieces reordered by hand: a new phrase at each run
reordered, accent words hidden only in their run
a word with its middle cut is left out

overlay.name: style of the reference: soft, hook accent, accent phrase, title, inserts, still frame and end card
karaoke with a teaser, plate hook, badge and animation inserts, version for ads
pieces reordered by hand: accent typed in a moved piece, insert across a run, title in a moved piece
two accents close together: letters and track, lines whose words are not found, zoom out
things at the very end stay on the still frame; an accent there does not leave
tricky times: half-frame rounding, overlapping words

overlayRefused.name: an insert drawn by the layer needs a place on the frame

render.name: a half frame rounds to even
nothing past the last frame of the source
a piece shorter than a frame disappears

renderRefused.name: teaser past the end of the source

look.name: steps by meaning, a sharp change of shot at a cut, a slow push-in; zoom and flash transitions
pieces reordered by hand: each run starts at the level of its first moment in source order
with a teaser: a look in the teaser phrase shows in the teaser too; levels clamp to their range

beats.name: inserts and zooms land on beats within 0.25 s; a sharp change of shot stays at its cut
music later and from its middle; a short track repeats
pieces reordered by hand: an insert does not jump across a join into another piece
with a teaser: no beat inside the teaser; the music starts after its end

text.name: every kind of block: hook, title, accents, inserts and words
edits of blocks the session moved or removed no longer apply; lines of another count stay
hook and title switched off; a hook edit without a hook changes nothing
